auto.script:
set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode'
exec 9>'/home/user/.rayito/agent/run.lock'
if ! flock -n 9; then printf '%s\n' '{"type":"rayito.busy"}'; exit 0; fi
if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' '{"type":"rayito.runtime_missing"}'; exit 0; fi
attach=auto
attached=0
secret='/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret'
if [ "$attach" != never ] && [ -r "$secret" ]; then
  OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD="$(cat "$secret")"
  export OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD
  if curl -fsS -m 1 -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD" 'http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    attached=1
  fi
fi
sid=''
created=0
if [ "$attached" = 1 ]; then
  sha="$(sha256sum "$OPENCODE_CONFIG" | cut -d " " -f 1)"
  if [ "$sha" != "$(cat '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/applied.sha256' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    curl -fsS -m 5 -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD" -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:4096/instance/dispose?directory=%2Fhome%2Fuser' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    printf '%s\n' "$sha" > '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/applied.sha256'
  fi
  if [ -z "$sid" ]; then
    sid="$(curl -fsS -m 5 -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{"title":"rayito","permission":[{"permission":"question","action":"deny","pattern":"*"},{"permission":"plan_enter","action":"deny","pattern":"*"},{"permission":"plan_exit","action":"deny","pattern":"*"}]}' 'http://127.0.0.1:4096/session?directory=%2Fhome%2Fuser' 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"id":"ses_[A-Za-z0-9]*"' | head -n 1 | cut -d '"' -f 4)"
    if [ -n "$sid" ]; then created=1; else attached=0; fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$attach" = always ] && [ "$attached" = 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"type":"rayito.runtime_missing"}'
  exit 0
fi
set -- 'opencode' 'run' '--format' 'json' '--auto' '--title' 'rayito' '--dir' '/home/user'
if [ "$attached" = 0 ]; then exec "$@"; fi
since="$(date +%s%3N)"
printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"rayito.attached\",\"sessionID\":\"$sid\",\"since\":$since,\"reasoning\":false}"
if [ "$created" = 1 ]; then set -- "$@" -s "$sid"; fi
set -- "$@" --attach 'http://127.0.0.1:4096'
rc=0
"$@" || rc=$?
tmp="$(mktemp)"
before=""
n=0
while [ "$n" -lt 512 ]; do
  n=$((n + 1))
  page="$(curl -fsS -m 5 -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD" -D "$tmp.h" "http://127.0.0.1:4096/session/$sid/message?directory=%2Fhome%2Fuser&limit=1${before:+&before=$before}" 2>/dev/null)" || break
  page="${page#\[}"
  page="${page%\]}"
  [ -n "$page" ] || break
  printf '{"type":"rayito.message","message":%s}\n' "$page" >> "$tmp"
  if printf '%s' "$page" | grep -Eq '^\{"info":\{[^{}]*"role":"user"'; then break; fi
  before="$(tr -d '\r' < "$tmp.h" | sed -n 's/^[Xx]-[Nn]ext-[Cc]ursor: *//p')"
  [ -n "$before" ] || break
done
tac "$tmp"
rm -f "$tmp" "$tmp.h"
exit "$rc"
